verses.original: Ἦν δὲ ἄνθρωπος ἐκ τῶν Φαρισαίων Νικόδημος ὄνομα αὐτῷ ἄρχων τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: Ēn de anthrōpos ek tōn Pharisaiōn Nikodēmos onoma autō archōn tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named . . . Nicodemus a leader of the Jews
verses.literalPt: Havia um homem, dentre os fariseus, chamado Nicodemos, principal entre os judeus.

verses.original: οὗτος ἦλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν νυκτὸς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ῥαββί οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἐλήλυθας διδάσκαλος οὐδεὶς γὰρ δύναται ταῦτα τὰ σημεῖα ποιεῖν ἃ σὺ ποιεῖς ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ ὁ Θεὸς μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtos ēlthen pros auton nyktos kai eipen autō Rhabbi oidamen hoti apo Theou elēlythas didaskalos oudeis gar dynatai tauta ta sēmeia poiein ha sy poieis ean mē ē ho Theos met’ autou
verses.literal: He came to Jesus at night and said Rabbi we know that You are a teacher who has come from God For no one could perform the signs You are doing if God were not with him
verses.literalPt: Este foi ter com Jesus de noite e disse-lhe: Rabi, sabemos que és mestre vindo da parte de Deus; pois ninguém pode fazer estes milagres que tu fazes, se Deus não estiver com ele.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἄνωθεν οὐ δύναται ἰδεῖν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autō Amēn amēn legō soi ean mē tis gennēthē anōthen ou dynatai idein tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . Truly truly I tell you no one can see the kingdom of God unless . . . he is born again
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu-lhe: Em verdade, em verdade te digo que, se alguém não nascer de novo, não pode ver o reino de Deus.

verses.original: Λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Νικόδημος Πῶς δύναται ἄνθρωπος γεννηθῆναι γέρων ὤν μὴ δύναται εἰς τὴν κοιλίαν τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ δεύτερον εἰσελθεῖν καὶ γεννηθῆναι
verses.transliteration: Legei pros auton ho Nikodēmos Pōs dynatai anthrōpos gennēthēnai gerōn ōn mē dynatai eis tēn koilian tēs mētros autou deuteron eiselthein kai gennēthēnai
verses.literal: How can a man be born when he is old Nicodemus asked - Can he enter . . . - his mother’s womb a second time to be born
verses.literalPt: Perguntou-lhe Nicodemos: Como pode um homem nascer, sendo velho? Pode, porventura, entrar novamente no ventre de sua mãe e nascer?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ἐὰν μή τις γεννηθῇ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ Πνεύματος οὐ δύναται εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous Amēn amēn legō soi ean mē tis gennēthē ex hydatos kai Pneumatos ou dynatai eiselthein eis tēn basileian tou Theou
verses.literal: Jesus answered Truly truly I tell you no one can enter . . . the kingdom of God unless . . . he is born of water and the Spirit
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Em verdade, em verdade te digo que, se alguém não nascer da água e do Espírito, não pode entrar no reino de Deus.

verses.original: τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τῆς σαρκὸς σάρξ ἐστιν καὶ τὸ γεγεννημένον ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος πνεῦμά ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: to gegennēmenon ek tēs sarkos sarx estin kai to gegennēmenon ek tou Pneumatos pneuma estin
verses.literal: Flesh is born of flesh but spirit is born of the Spirit
verses.literalPt: O que é nascido da carne é carne; e o que é nascido do Espírito é espírito.

verses.original: μὴ θαυμάσῃς ὅτι εἶπόν σοι Δεῖ ὑμᾶς γεννηθῆναι ἄνωθεν
verses.transliteration: mē thaumasēs hoti eipon soi Dei hymas gennēthēnai anōthen
verses.literal: Do not be amazed that I said You must be born again
verses.literalPt: Não te maravilhes de eu te dizer: É-vos necessário nascer de novo.

verses.original: τὸ πνεῦμα ὅπου θέλει πνεῖ καὶ τὴν φωνὴν αὐτοῦ ἀκούεις ἀλλ’ οὐκ οἶδας πόθεν ἔρχεται καὶ ποῦ ὑπάγει οὕτως ἐστὶν πᾶς ὁ γεγεννημένος ἐκ τοῦ Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: to pneuma hopou thelei pnei kai tēn phōnēn autou akoueis all’ ouk oidas pothen erchetai kai pou hypagei houtōs estin pas ho gegennēmenos ek tou Pneumatos
verses.literal: The wind blows where it wishes You hear its sound but you do not know where it comes from or where it is going So it is with everyone born of the Spirit
verses.literalPt: O vento sopra onde quer, e ouves a sua voz, mas não sabes donde vem, nem para onde vai; assim é todo aquele que é nascido do Espírito.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Νικόδημος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Πῶς δύναται ταῦτα γενέσθαι
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Nikodēmos kai eipen autō Pōs dynatai tauta genesthai
verses.literal: How can this be Nicodemus asked . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Como pode ser isso? — perguntou-lhe Nicodemos.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Σὺ εἶ ὁ διδάσκαλος τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ καὶ ταῦτα οὐ γινώσκεις
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autō Sy ei ho didaskalos tou Israēl kai tauta ou ginōskeis
verses.literal: You are Israel’s teacher said Jesus . . . . . . . . . and you do not understand these things
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Tu és mestre em Israel e não entendes essas coisas?

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτι ὃ οἴδαμεν λαλοῦμεν καὶ ὃ ἑωράκαμεν μαρτυροῦμεν καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἡμῶν οὐ λαμβάνετε
verses.transliteration: amēn amēn legō soi hoti ho oidamen laloumen kai ho heōrakamen martyroumen kai tēn martyrian hēmōn ou lambanete
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you we speak of what we know and we testify to what we have seen and yet you people do not accept our testimony
verses.literalPt: Em verdade, em verdade te digo que falamos o que sabemos e testificamos o que temos visto, e não recebeis o nosso testemunho.

verses.original: Εἰ τὰ ἐπίγεια εἶπον ὑμῖν καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε πῶς ἐὰν εἴπω ὑμῖν τὰ ἐπουράνια πιστεύσετε
verses.transliteration: Ei ta epigeia eipon hymin kai ou pisteuete pōs ean eipō hymin ta epourania pisteusete
verses.literal: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things
verses.literalPt: Se vos tenho falado das coisas terrenas, e não me credes, como crereis, se vos falar das celestiais?

verses.original: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἀναβέβηκεν εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εἰ μὴ ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καταβάς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: kai oudeis anabebēken eis ton ouranon ei mē ho ek tou ouranou katabas ho Huios tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: No one has ascended into heaven except . . . the One who descended from heaven the Son of Man
verses.literalPt: Ninguém subiu ao céu, senão aquele que desceu do céu, a saber, o Filho do Homem.

verses.original: καὶ καθὼς Μωϋσῆς ὕψωσεν τὸν ὄφιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ οὕτως ὑψωθῆναι δεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: kai kathōs Mōusēs hypsōsen ton ophin en tē erēmō houtōs hypsōthēnai dei ton Huion tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness so the Son of Man must be lifted up
verses.literalPt: Como Moisés levantou a serpente no deserto, assim importa que o Filho do Homem seja levantado,

verses.original: ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων ἐν αὐτῷ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: hina pas ho pisteuōn en autō echē zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life
verses.literalPt: para que todo o que nele crê tenha a vida eterna.

verses.original: Οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν κόσμον ὥστε τὸν Υἱὸν τὸν μονογενῆ ἔδωκεν ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν μὴ ἀπόληται ἀλλ’ ἔχῃ ζωὴν αἰώνιον
verses.transliteration: Houtōs gar ēgapēsen ho Theos ton kosmon hōste ton Huion ton monogenē edōken hina pas ho pisteuōn eis auton mē apolētai all’ echē zōēn aiōnion
verses.literal: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life
verses.literalPt: Pois assim amou Deus ao mundo que deu seu Filho unigênito, para que todo o que nele crê não pereça, mas tenha a vida eterna.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Υἱὸν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα κρίνῃ τὸν κόσμον ἀλλ’ ἵνα σωθῇ ὁ κόσμος δι’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ou gar apesteilen ho Theos ton Huion eis ton kosmon hina krinē ton kosmon all’ hina sōthē ho kosmos di’ autou
verses.literal: For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world but to save the world through Him
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus não enviou o Filho ao mundo para julgar o mundo, mas para que o mundo seja salvo por ele.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς αὐτὸν οὐ κρίνεται ὁ δὲ μὴ πιστεύων ἤδη κέκριται ὅτι μὴ πεπίστευκεν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ μονογενοῦς Υἱοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho pisteuōn eis auton ou krinetai ho de mē pisteuōn ēdē kekritai hoti mē pepisteuken eis to onoma tou monogenous Huiou tou Theou
verses.literal: Whoever believes in Him is not condemned but whoever does not believe has already been condemned because he has not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son
verses.literalPt: Quem nele crê não é julgado; o que não crê já está julgado, porque não crê no nome do Filho unigênito de Deus.

verses.original: Αὕτη δέ ἐστιν ἡ κρίσις ὅτι τὸ φῶς ἐλήλυθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον καὶ ἠγάπησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι μᾶλλον τὸ σκότος ἢ τὸ φῶς ἦν γὰρ αὐτῶν πονηρὰ τὰ ἔργα
verses.transliteration: Hautē de estin hē krisis hoti to phōs elēlythen eis ton kosmon kai ēgapēsan hoi anthrōpoi mallon to skotos ē to phōs ēn gar autōn ponēra ta erga
verses.literal: And this is the verdict The Light has come into the world but men loved the darkness rather than the Light because their deeds were evil
verses.literalPt: O juízo é este: que a luz veio ao mundo, e os homens amaram mais as trevas do que a luz; pois eram más as suas obras.

verses.original: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ φαῦλα πράσσων μισεῖ τὸ φῶς καὶ οὐκ ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς ἵνα μὴ ἐλεγχθῇ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: pas gar ho phaula prassōn misei to phōs kai ouk erchetai pros to phōs hina mē elenchthē ta erga autou
verses.literal: Everyone who does evil hates the Light and does not come into the Light for fear that . . . his deeds will be exposed
verses.literalPt: Porquanto todo aquele que pratica o mal aborrece a luz e não vem para a luz, a fim de que as suas obras não sejam arguidas;

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ποιῶν τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸ φῶς ἵνα φανερωθῇ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα ὅτι ἐν Θεῷ ἐστιν εἰργασμένα
verses.transliteration: ho de poiōn tēn alētheian erchetai pros to phōs hina phanerōthē autou ta erga hoti en Theō estin eirgasmena
verses.literal: But whoever practices the truth comes into the Light so that it may be seen clearly that what he has done has been accomplished in God
verses.literalPt: mas aquele que faz o bem chega-se para a luz, a fim de que sejam manifestas as suas obras, que têm sido feitas em Deus.

verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν γῆν καὶ ἐκεῖ διέτριβεν μετ’ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐβάπτιζεν
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta ēlthen ho Iēsous kai hoi mathētai autou eis tēn Ioudaian gēn kai ekei dietriben met’ autōn kai ebaptizen
verses.literal: After this Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside where He spent some time with them and baptized
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, foi Jesus com seus discípulos para a terra da Judeia; ali se demorava com eles e batizava.

verses.original: Ἦν δὲ καὶ ὁ Ἰωάννης βαπτίζων ἐν Αἰνὼν ἐγγὺς τοῦ Σαλείμ ὅτι ὕδατα πολλὰ ἦν ἐκεῖ καὶ παρεγίνοντο καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο
verses.transliteration: Ēn de kai ho Iōannēs baptizōn en Ainōn engys tou Saleim hoti hydata polla ēn ekei kai pareginonto kai ebaptizonto
verses.literal: Now John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim because the water was plentiful there and people kept coming to be baptized
verses.literalPt: João também estava batizando em Enom, perto de Salim, porque havia ali muitas águas, e o povo ia e era batizado.

verses.original: οὔπω γὰρ ἦν βεβλημένος εἰς τὴν φυλακὴν ὁ Ἰωάννης
verses.transliteration: oupō gar ēn beblēmenos eis tēn phylakēn ho Iōannēs
verses.literal: (For John had not yet been thrown into prison
verses.literalPt: Pois João não tinha sido ainda lançado no cárcere.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο οὖν ζήτησις ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν Ἰωάννου μετὰ Ἰουδαίου περὶ καθαρισμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egeneto oun zētēsis ek tōn mathētōn Iōannou meta Ioudaiou peri katharismou
verses.literal: Then a dispute arose between John’s disciples and a certain Jew over the issue of ceremonial washing
verses.literalPt: Ora, levantou-se uma discussão entre os discípulos de João e um judeu acerca da purificação.

verses.original: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ῥαββί ὃς ἦν μετὰ σοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ᾧ σὺ μεμαρτύρηκας ἴδε οὗτος βαπτίζει καὶ πάντες ἔρχονται πρὸς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai ēlthon pros ton Iōannēn kai eipan autō Rhabbi hos ēn meta sou peran tou Iordanou hō sy memartyrēkas ide houtos baptizei kai pantes erchontai pros auton
verses.literal: So John’s disciples came to him and said . . . Look Rabbi the One who was with you beyond the Jordan the One you testified about He is baptizing and everyone is going to Him
verses.literalPt: Eles foram ter com João e disseram-lhe: Mestre, aquele que estava contigo além do Jordão, de quem tens dado testemunho, ei-lo aí está batizando, e todos vão a ele.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰωάννης καὶ εἶπεν Οὐ δύναται ἄνθρωπος λαμβάνειν οὐδὲ ἓν ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ δεδομένον αὐτῷ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iōannēs kai eipen Ou dynatai anthrōpos lambanein oude hen ean mē ē dedomenon autō ek tou ouranou
verses.literal: John replied . . . . . . A man can receive only what . . . . . . . . . is given him from heaven
verses.literalPt: Respondeu João: O homem não pode receber coisa alguma se do céu não lhe for dada.

verses.original: αὐτοὶ ὑμεῖς μοι μαρτυρεῖτε ὅτι εἶπον ὅτι Οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὁ Χριστός ἀλλ’ ὅτι Ἀπεσταλμένος εἰμὶ ἔμπροσθεν ἐκείνου
verses.transliteration: autoi hymeis moi martyreite hoti eipon hoti Ouk eimi egō ho Christos all’ hoti Apestalmenos eimi emprosthen ekeinou
verses.literal: You yourselves can testify that I said I am not the Christ but am sent ahead of Him
verses.literalPt: Vós mesmos me sois testemunhas de que eu disse: Eu não sou o Cristo, mas sou enviado adiante dele.

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων τὴν νύμφην νυμφίος ἐστίν ὁ δὲ φίλος τοῦ νυμφίου ὁ ἑστηκὼς καὶ ἀκούων αὐτοῦ χαρᾷ χαίρει διὰ τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ νυμφίου αὕτη οὖν ἡ χαρὰ ἡ ἐμὴ πεπλήρωται
verses.transliteration: HO echōn tēn nymphēn nymphios estin ho de philos tou nymphiou ho hestēkōs kai akouōn autou chara chairei dia tēn phōnēn tou nymphiou hautē oun hē chara hē emē peplērōtai
verses.literal: The bride belongs to . . . . . . the bridegroom The friend of the bridegroom stands and listens for him and is overjoyed . . . to hear the bridegroom’s voice That . . . joy is mine and it is now complete
verses.literalPt: O que tem a esposa é o esposo; mas o amigo do esposo, que está presente e o ouve, muito se regozija por causa da voz do esposo. Pois este meu gozo está completo.

verses.original: ἐκεῖνον δεῖ αὐξάνειν ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαττοῦσθαι
verses.transliteration: ekeinon dei auxanein eme de elattousthai
verses.literal: He must increase I must decrease
verses.literalPt: É necessário que ele cresça e que eu diminua.

verses.original: Ὁ ἄνωθεν ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν ὁ ὢν ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς λαλεῖ ὁ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐρχόμενος ἐπάνω πάντων ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: Ho anōthen erchomenos epanō pantōn estin ho ōn ek tēs gēs ek tēs gēs estin kai ek tēs gēs lalei ho ek tou ouranou erchomenos epanō pantōn estin
verses.literal: The One who comes from above is above all The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth The One who comes from heaven is above all
verses.literalPt: O que vem de cima é sobre todos; o que é da terra é da terra e fala da terra. O que vem do céu é sobre todos;

verses.original: ὃ ἑώρακεν καὶ ἤκουσεν τοῦτο μαρτυρεῖ καὶ τὴν μαρτυρίαν αὐτοῦ οὐδεὶς λαμβάνει
verses.transliteration: ho heōraken kai ēkousen touto martyrei kai tēn martyrian autou oudeis lambanei
verses.literal: He testifies to what He has seen and heard yet no one accepts His testimony
verses.literalPt: o que ele tem visto e ouvido, isso testifica; e ninguém recebe o seu testemunho.

verses.original: ὁ λαβὼν αὐτοῦ τὴν μαρτυρίαν ἐσφράγισεν ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ἀληθής ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ho labōn autou tēn martyrian esphragisen hoti ho Theos alēthēs estin
verses.literal: Whoever accepts His testimony has certified that God is truthful
verses.literalPt: O que recebeu o seu testemunho, este certificou que Deus é verdadeiro.

verses.original: ὃν γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ Θεὸς τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ Θεοῦ λαλεῖ οὐ γὰρ ἐκ μέτρου δίδωσιν τὸ Πνεῦμα
verses.transliteration: hon gar apesteilen ho Theos ta rhēmata tou Theou lalei ou gar ek metrou didōsin to Pneuma
verses.literal: For the One whom God has sent speaks the words of God for God gives the Spirit without . . . limit
verses.literalPt: Pois aquele que Deus enviou fala as palavras de Deus; porque ele não dá o Espírito por medida.

verses.original: Ὁ Πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ τὸν Υἱόν καὶ πάντα δέδωκεν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho Patēr agapa ton Huion kai panta dedōken en tē cheiri autou
verses.literal: The Father loves the Son and has placed all things in His hands
verses.literalPt: O Pai ama ao Filho e tudo tem posto nas suas mãos.

verses.original: ὁ πιστεύων εἰς τὸν Υἱὸν ἔχει ζωὴν αἰώνιον ὁ δὲ ἀπειθῶν τῷ Υἱῷ οὐκ ὄψεται ζωήν ἀλλ’ ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ Θεοῦ μένει ἐπ’ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ho pisteuōn eis ton Huion echei zōēn aiōnion ho de apeithōn tō Huiō ouk opsetai zōēn all’ hē orgē tou Theou menei ep’ auton
verses.literal: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life Whoever rejects the Son will not see life Instead the wrath of God remains on him
verses.literalPt: O que crê no Filho tem a vida eterna; o que, porém, desobedece ao Filho não verá a vida, mas sobre ele permanece a ira de Deus.
